  • Sustainable infrastructure
  • Energy and renewable energy
  • Digital transformation and connectivity
  • Transport infrastructure and mobility
  • Water, sanitation, and environmental management
  • Private sector development and investment promotion
  • Climate resilience and green transition
  • Public sector reforms linked to investment and infrastructure development


Key Responsibilities

Selected experts may support activities such as:

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of reform strategies and policy actions
  • Supporting coordination across EU Global Gateway priority sectors and stakeholders
  • Assisting in the identification and preparation of investment projects aligned with Global Gateway priorities
  • Conducting or contributing to regulatory , institutional , and sector analyses
  • Supporting feasibility preparation and investment pipeline development
  • Facilitating coordination between partner-country institutions, IFIs, Team Europe actors, private sector stakeholders, and development partners

title: Coordenador(a) de Marketing (Branding e Campanhas) I Santo André

Buscamos alguém com postura e energia comercial, escuta ativa e maturidade para lidar com negociações importantes. Uma pessoa que saiba construir confiança, cobrar avanço, organizar oportunidades e fechar negócios.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.

title: Direct-Response Creative Strategist
description:
About us

Clickbait Agency is a YouTube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on YouTube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.

We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.

We think YouTube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.


The role

We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script YouTube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.

You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.

You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.


What we’re looking for

We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.

You should have:

  • 2+ years writing direct response video ads for YouTube or Facebook
  • A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic
  • Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts
  • The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative
  • Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale
  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow

Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.


What we offer

Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.

You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.

This is a fully remote position.


One thing worth knowing

There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS and Azure)
description:
About the Company


Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.



Position Overview:


We are seeking a motivated and results-oriented Senior Cloud Engineer with experience in two or more cloud technologies (AWS or Azure) to join our growing team in a support, engineering, and consulting role. In this role, you will work closely with our senior architects, engineers and consultants to assist clients in designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions. This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in cloud architecture, develop technical expertise, and contribute to the success of our clients.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage and respond to customer-facing support tickets, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with senior architects and consultants to understand client requirements and develop and support scalable cloud-based solutions.
  • Apply best practice framework principles to evaluate and improve client architecture.
  • Apply FinOps best practices to monitor, analyze, and optimize cloud costs, including cost allocation, budget tracking, and implementing cost-saving strategies.
  • Support and assist clients with AI/ML workloads and implementations using cloud provider services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and other AI tools.
  • Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure components such as virtual compute instances (VMs & containers), storage services, databases, and virtual networks (VNet & VPC).
  • Provide technical support to clients, including troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and ensuring security best practices.
  • Configure and manage cloud resources, including virtual compute instances, storage services, databases, virtual networks, and more.
  • Develop and document infrastructure as code (IaC) using tools like Amazon CloudFormation & CDK, Azure ARM, Azure Bicap, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, or Terraform.
  • Contribute to DevOps workflows using tools such as Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Deployment and Amazon CodePipeline.
  • Maintain awareness and proficiency on cloud services, features, and best practices to provide expert guidance and support to clients.
  • Contribute to the development of documentation, training materials, and best practices guides for internal and external use.
  • Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.


What We're Looking For:


  • Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment.
  • At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.
  • Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security.
  • Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices.
  • Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices.
  • Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services.
  • Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows.
  • Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.


Bonus Points For:


  • Certifications in more than one cloud provider
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools.
  • Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services.
  • Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices.
  • Experience in a technology consulting environment.
  • Experience with multiple cloud platforms.


What We Offer:


  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement.
  • Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies.
  • Continuous learning and professional development opportunities including training and certification programs.


Join our team and embark on a rewarding career journey as a Cloud Engineer, where you will play a vital role in helping our clients succeed in the cloud. Apply now to become part of our innovative and dynamic team!


Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at .


Sycomp complies with applicable AI regulations worldwide and adheres to the most rigorous standards. As such, our organization may use automated tools including artificial intelligence, to support certain aspects of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications or identifying relevant experience and education. These tools assist our teams, and all final hiring decisions are made following human review. If you have questions or concerns about our process, please contact us at .

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a SwarmBench Task Engineer specializing in planning and operations to design and build complex, multi-agent benchmark tasks that simulate real-world planning, scheduling, and operational decision-making scenarios. This role focuses on creating constraint-rich problems that evaluate multi-agent reasoning, decomposition, and optimization capabilities in realistic environments.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Design and develop multi-agent benchmark tasks involving:
  • Planning, scheduling, and resource allocation
  • Operational decision-making (project management, logistics, incident response, capacity planning)
  • Create constraint-rich problem statements with multiple interacting variables
  • Develop verification scripts to evaluate:
  • Feasibility (all constraints satisfied)
  • Completeness (all requirements addressed)
  • Optimality (efficient solutions)
  • Build decomposition strategies:
  • Split tasks across specialized sub-agents (resource-based, constraint-based, conflict resolution, optimization)
  • Model real-world operational scenarios with dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints
  • Collaborate on improving task quality, coverage, and evaluation rigor


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in operations, project management, logistics, or supply chain

  • Proficiency in Python for building verification and validation scripts
  • Strong structured problem-solving and decomposition skills

  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-bench)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with optimization techniques (linear programming, constraint satisfaction, scheduling algorithms)

description:
Location: Dalian, China (initial phase) | Brazil Offshore (subsequent operations)

Rights to Work: Brazil

Employment Type: Contractor / Rotational


Role Description

We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Supervisor to join a major offshore oil and gas project, initially based at a shipyard in Dalian, China during the construction and pre-commissioning phase, before mobilising to Brazil for offshore operations. The successful candidate will play a critical role in overseeing mechanical installation, inspection, and commissioning activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, and client requirements.


Construction & Commissioning Phase (Dalian, China)

  • Supervise and coordinate all mechanical installation activities at the shipyard, including rotating equipment, static equipment, piping systems, and structural mechanical components
  • Review and interpret engineering drawings, P&IDs, isometrics, and equipment data sheets
  • Monitor contractor and vendor progress against project schedules, flagging deviations and driving corrective actions
  • Conduct daily site walks and formal inspections, ensuring work is executed in accordance with approved procedures and specifications
  • Attend and participate in FAT (Factory Acceptance Tests) and SAT (Site Acceptance Tests) for mechanical equipment
  • Interface with QA/QC teams to ensure all mechanical work packages are correctly documented, punch-listed, and closed out
  • Liaise with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to resolve technical queries and NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) in a timely manner
  • Support Pre-Commissioning and Commissioning activities in preparation for sail-away


Offshore Operations Phase (Brazil)

  • Supervise mechanical maintenance and operational activities in accordance with the approved maintenance management system
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements (ANP, IBAMA) and applicable international standards (API, ASME, ISO)
  • Lead and coordinate mechanical shutdown and turnaround activities
  • Monitor equipment condition and performance, recommending preventive and corrective maintenance strategies
  • Support HSE initiatives and enforce permit-to-work systems (PTW) at all times



Requirements

  • Mechanical supervision experience in offshore or FPSO projects
  • Proven shipyard construction experience, ideally in Asia
  • Strong background in rotating and static equipment
  • Proficiency in engineering drawings, international codes (ASME, API, ABNT), and CMMS platforms
  • Degree or technical diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent trade qualification)
  • Valid offshore survival certification (OPITO/HUET); NR-10, NR-33, NR-37 required or to be obtained
  • Fluency in Portuguese mandatory; working English essential

Além das habilidades técnicas, o candidato deve possuir competências profissionais como comunicação técnica clara, autonomia para tomar decisões e a capacidade de atuar em contextos de negócios complexos.

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

title: Remote Sales Representative | Marketing & Lead Generation Agency
description:
Company Description

Next Level Growth is a full-service marketing and media agency helping service-based businesses grow through strategic content, paid advertising, lead generation, video production, and social media growth strategies.


We work with businesses across industries such as plastic surgery, med spas, home services, luxury brands, and other service-based companies that want to increase visibility, generate qualified leads, and turn attention into real revenue.


Our focus is simple: create marketing systems that look professional, build trust, and drive measurable growth. From high-performing ad campaigns to scroll-stopping content and conversion-focused digital strategies, we help our clients boost their online presence and scale with confidence.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote position for a Sales Representative at Next Level Growth.

The Sales Representative will be responsible for identifying, contacting, qualifying, and closing potential clients who may benefit from our marketing and lead generation services. This role involves speaking with business owners, understanding their goals and challenges, presenting tailored marketing solutions, handling objections, following up consistently, and helping convert qualified prospects into clients.


Day-to-day responsibilities include prospecting new opportunities, managing inbound and outbound conversations, presenting NLG’s services, booking and conducting sales calls, updating the CRM, and working closely with the internal marketing team to ensure a strong client experience from the first conversation.


This role is ideal for someone who is confident, organized, self-motivated, and comfortable selling marketing services in a fast-paced remote environment.


Qualifications


-Strong communication, sales, and customer service skills

-Proven experience in sales, appointment setting, business development, or closing deals

-Ability to identify qualified prospects, build relationships, and guide conversations toward a clear next step

-Familiarity with digital marketing, paid advertising, lead generation, social media, or agency services is strongly preferred

-Comfortable speaking with business owners and decision-makers

-Ability to handle objections professionally and follow up consistently

-Goal-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently in a remote environment

-Experience using CRM tools, sales pipelines, calendars, and sales management software is a plus

-Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

-Fluent English required

-Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is preferred but not required


Compensation


Compensation is performance-based and may include base pay, commission, or a combination depending on experience.


Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is hungry, coachable, confident, and motivated by results. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, follows up consistently, and understands that great sales come from solving real business problems — not just pushing a service.

This person should be excited to grow with a fast-moving agency and contribute directly to the company’s growth.

title: Designer
description:
Sobre o Studio Yellow

No Studio Yellow, somos uma agência premium global especializada em transformar marcas através de design inovador e estratégia de ponta. Atuamos como parceiros de crescimento para empresas líderes, criando experiências centradas no usuário que unem o melhor da inteligência artificial com a arte da criatividade humana. Nosso trabalho vai muito além de capturar a atenção; nós construímos conexões significativas que geram engajamento e lealdade duradouros. Com um time altamente engajado e uma cultura 100% remota, colaboramos em projetos de impacto nacional e internacional, sempre com um compromisso inegociável com a excelência.


O Papel

Estamos em busca de um designer versátil , criativo e com um olhar afiado para a excelência. Se você é apaixonado por criar soluções visuais que não apenas encantam, mas também resolvem problemas estratégicos, este é o seu lugar. Como parte do nosso time, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em projetos diversificados, desde a concepção de identidades visuais, design de posts para social media, até o design de interfaces (UI/UX) e materiais para campanhas digitais e impressas. Você trabalhará lado a lado com uma equipe multidisciplinar e talentosa, lidando com clientes globais e elevando o padrão de qualidade em cada entrega.


O que você fará no dia a dia

Sua rotina envolverá a criação de ativos visuais de alta qualidade para diversos formatos, incluindo digital, print, social media e apresentações premium. Além disso, atuará como um guardião da marca, garantindo que todas as entregas estejam perfeitamente alinhadas com as diretrizes e a estratégia de marca dos nossos clientes.


A colaboração criativa será uma parte fundamental do seu trabalho. Você participará ativamente de brainstormings, trazendo ideias inovadoras e colaborando com times de estratégia, conteúdo e tecnologia. A busca pela excelência guiará suas ações, exigindo que você itere sobre feedbacks de forma construtiva e refine cada detalhe para garantir que o resultado final seja nada menos que excepcional.


O que buscamos em você

Procuramos um profissional com um portfólio de impacto, que demonstre forte habilidade em design gráfico e narrativa visual, além de um domínio impecável de tipografia, layout e teoria das cores. É essencial ter proficiência avançada nas principais ferramentas de design, como Figma e Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).


A versatilidade é uma característica chave que buscamos, pois você precisará transitar entre diferentes estilos e formatos, adaptando-se às necessidades de projetos nacionais e internacionais.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração são necessárias para articular e defender suas ideias de design de forma clara, além de trabalhar bem em um ambiente remoto e colaborativo.


Conhecimentos em motion design, edição básica de vídeo ou familiaridade com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao design serão considerados diferenciais muito bem-vindos.


Por que o Studio Yellow?

Ao se juntar ao Studio Yellow, você terá a oportunidade de atuar globalmente, trabalhando em projetos desafiadores para marcas de destaque no Brasil e no mundo. Você fará parte de uma cultura premium, em uma agência que valoriza a qualidade extrema e a inovação em cada detalhe.


Oferecemos liberdade e flexibilidade através de um ambiente 100% remoto, permitindo que você trabalhe de onde se sentir mais inspirado, com autonomia e responsabilidade. Acima de tudo, você se juntará a um time inspirador de profissionais apaixonados e engajados, em um espaço que fomenta o crescimento contínuo e a troca de conhecimentos.


Se você tem o talento para transformar estratégia em arte e a ambição de entregar o extraordinário, queremos conhecer você.


Venha construir o futuro das marcas com o Studio Yellow!

title: Psicóloga(o) Pleno - Foco em APS

Olá, somos o Sírio-Libanês!

Somos uma instituição de saúde centenária, que através da sua atuação em mais de 60 especialidades, tem como propósito levar vida plena e digna a um número cada vez maior de pessoas. A cada ano, contribuímos para a formação de profissionais da saúde e atendemos milhares de pacientes.

Nos orgulhamos do nosso caráter filantrópico, de um compromisso social genuíno e de sermos uma das melhores instituições de saúde do mundo reconhecida pela revista Newsweek (2023), além de sermos uma empresa TOP Employers, nos destacando entre as melhores instituições do mundo em práticas de Recursos Humanos.

Desta maneira, acreditamos que a diversidade é fator fundamental que molda a nossa cultura. Venha com a gente nessa jornada por mais inclusão, diversidade, equidade, representatividade e proporcionalidade.

Queremos você para fazer parte dessa história!

Neste desafio, você será responsável por:

  • Realizar atendimentos a pessoas em situação de sofrimento psíquico via plataforma digital;

  • Atuar por meio de protocolos assistenciais, diretrizes técnicas e evidências científicas.

Para este desafio, você precisará ter:

  • Graduação completa em Psicologia com registro ativo no CRP e cadastro regulamentado no E-Psi;

  • Experiência de 6 meses comprovada em UBS e/ou serviços de APS;

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior AppSec Analyst (BRL 17K/month CLT + benefits)
description:
1-2X/WEEK AT THE OFFICE, NEAR PAULISTA AVENUE (CONSOLAÇÃO STATION)

Purpose of the job


As a DevSecOps Engineer, you’ll contribute to a security-first approach. This is an opportunity to shape the foundations of a resilient platform with security embedded throughout the software development lifecycle, implementing automated security controls and establishing security best practices.


This hands-on role requires security by design, championing shift-left security practices and establishing security automation across our route to live, incorporating static and dynamic security testing, vulnerability management and remediation, and improvements on current security posture and compliance.


You’ll benefit from fresh thinking with the opportunity to include pioneering innovative security approaches, with the freedom to explore AI.

If you're passionate about building secure-by-design systems, defining robust secure platforms, and leading the way in implementing security as code, this role offers the opportunity to do just that.


Key Responsibilities

● Security Strategy - Being the authority on running a secure platform and the technical security strategy, leading in improving and implementing security best practices such as AWS Well-Architected framework, zero trust principles, least privilege access control and disaster recovery within our platforms.

● Collaboration - Serve as the primary technical security liaison between engineering teams and security leadership, working closely with the CISO and assurance/governance teams to align security priorities with business objectives and risk management strategies

● Secure Development Practices - Champion security-first design patterns, integrate automated security testing and compliance validation into CI/CD pipelines, and implement GitOps security practices. Ensure deployments are secure-by-default with automated security gates, vulnerability scanning, and continuous compliance monitoring. This means writing real code, building proof-of-concepts, and diving into problem-solving.

● Security Evangelisation, Visualisation and Consistency - evangelising a security-conscious culture within our development teams. Develop and maintain security posture reporting and metrics that provide meaningful insights to stakeholders and guide development teams in implementing security best practices

● AI & Future Tech - We want to push the boundaries of AI-driven development - if you have ideas on how to embed AI into our security processes, you’ll have the space to explore them.


Your experience


● Tech stack - We use Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Python, AWS, Windows and Linux OS, Github Actions & Bitbucket Pipelines. You’re comfortable with all of these, and have extensive knowledge in Terraform and IaC principles, with extensive knowledge of CI/CD and the AWS ecosystem. Experience with TypeScript & Java is advantageous.

● Proven experience integrating security practices into the software development lifecycle, and you are proficient with compliance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, OWASP Top 10 & PCI DSS (v4). Experience with threat modelling is advantageous.

● Proven experience with secure cloud configuration and management of AWS services, familiarity with Network security, Encryption, Identity & Access Management

● Security Tooling & Automation - You have proven experience working with automating and configuring security tooling such as Vulnerability Management, Penetration Testing, DAST, SAST, & SIEM/SOC. Experience with Rapid7 Platform, Crowdstrike and Datadog is advantageous.

● CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code - You’ve deployed secure production systems using Terraform, Ansible and Helm, are comfortable with Linux and Windows based operating systems and have strong experience with CI/CD providers baking in security best practices.

● Observability Mindset - You believe in measuring everything. You’ve worked with DataDog, Rapid7 (or similar) to ensure teams have visibility into platform security.

title: Global Therapist: Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR)
description:
Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health. At Spring Health, we’re on a mission to revolutionize mental healthcare by removing every barrier that prevents people from getting the help they need, when they need it. Our clinically validated technology, Precision Mental Healthcare, empowers us to deliver the right care at the right time—whether it’s therapy, coaching, medication, or beyond—tailored to each individual’s needs. We proudly partner with over 450 companies, from startups to multinational Fortune 500 corporations, as a leading provider of mental health service, providing care for 10 million people. Our clients include brands you use and know like Microsoft, Target, and Delta Airlines, all of whom trust us to deliver best-in-class outcomes for their employees globally. With our innovative platform, we’ve been able to generate a net positive ROI for employers and we are the only company in our category to earn external validation of net savings for customers. We have raised capital from prominent investors including Generation Investment, Kinnevik, Tiger Global, William K Warren Foundation, Northzone, RRE Ventures, and many more. Thanks to their partnership and our latest Series E Funding, our current valuation has reached $3.3 billion. We’re just getting started—join us on our journey to make mental healthcare accessible to everyone, everywhere.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.
  • Integrated Critical Incident Response (ICIR) is a specialized service you can offer through Spring Health. It involves providing timely support to employees at organizations that are navigating workplace-related crises at both the macro level (natural disasters, civil unrest, etc.) and micro level (workforce reductions, death of a co-worker, etc.).
  • Employers might request your support for in-person or virtual group sessions, or 1:1 check-ins. This can include:
  • Group Support: Typically a 1-hour debriefing session with additional resources and follow-up care available through Spring Health.
  • 1:1 Support: 15-minute check-ins with the goal of normalizing the employee’s experience and connecting them to Spring Health for follow-up care if it's appropriate.

Who You Are:

  • You have an unrestricted license to practice counseling (Psychologist, Masters level counselor, etc.) in Brazil. We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring licensed supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure)
  • Minimum 3 years of total experience within mental health.
  • Have a dedicated office space in which to provide in-person therapy if you choose to provide those services.
  • You're comfortable with technology and are tele-health competent.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.
  • Previous experience delivering CIR services is preferred
  • You must be willing to travel up to one hour from your home to customer locations for delivery of in-person CIR services


Benefits of working with Spring Health:

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims---we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!


Not sure if you meet every requirement? Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.



Ready to do the most impactful work of your life? Learn more about our values, what it’s like to work here, and how hyper-growth meets impact at Spring Health: Our Values



Our privacy policy:



Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Ingeniero IaC — Terraform & Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description:
Sobre a VMetrix

A VMetrix é uma Fintech B2B que está transformando a forma como as instituições financeiras gerenciam investimentos, risco e tesouraria. Nossa plataforma SaaS Front to Back to Risk permite que bancos, seguradoras, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e outras instituições financeiras implementem tecnologia de nível mundial em meses, não em anos, com um modelo flexível e escalável. 

Operamos em múltiplos países e trabalhamos com organizações onde as decisões são tomadas por meio de comitês de compra, licitações e processos altamente rigorosos, em um ambiente onde confiança, reputação e certeza são determinantes.  


O Papel

Você será o arquiteto e guardião da infraestrutura cloud da VMetrix. Automatizará, provisionará e gerenciará todos os recursos OCI por meio do Terraform, garantindo ambientes reproduzíveis, seguros e altamente disponíveis que sustentam nossa plataforma financeira crítica.


Se você é Ex-Oracle ou Ex-OCI, esta vaga foi feita para você. Candidate-se sem hesitar.


Requisitos Eliminatórios - Sem exceção:

Experiência obrigatória

  • 5+ anos em infraestrutura cloud (comprovável)
  • 3+ años trabalhando diretamente com Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
  • 5+ anos de domínio prático de Terraform (módulos, remote state, workspaces, backends)
  • Graduação em Engenharia da Computação, Redes, Sistemas ou área correlata


OCI — Domínio técnico não negociável

  • Networking: VCN, subnets, Security Lists, NSGs, IGW, NAT GW, Service GW, DRG
  • Compute: VMs, BM, instance pools, autoscaling, custom images
  • Storage: Object Storage, Block Volumes, File Storage, Archive Storage
  • Bancos de dados: Oracle DB 21c EE, Autonomous DB, MySQL HeatWave
  • IAM: compartimentos, políticas, dynamic groups, instance principals
  • OCI DevOps: Code Repos, Build Pipelines, Deployment Pipelines
  • Observabilidade: OCI Monitoring, Logging, Notifications, Events


Terraform & IaC — Domínio avançado

  • Variables, outputs, módulos, remote state, terraform.tfvars, backends OCI Object Storage
  • Gestão de múltiplos workspaces e ambientes (Dev / QA / Prod)
  • Integração com CI/CD: OCI DevOps, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins ou GitHub Actions
  • Git e GitFlow para versionamento de infraestrutura


Segurança Cloud

  • IAM policies, criptografia KMS/Vault, Audit Service no OCI
  • Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), CIS Benchmarks para OCI
  • Gestão de segredos: OCI Vault e/ou HashiCorp Vault


Perfil Diferencial — O que coloca você à frente:

  • Ex-funcionário ou ex-contratado da Oracle com experiência em suporte, implementação ou arquitetura OCI → MÁXIMO diferencial do processo
  • Portfólio comprovado em OCI + Terraform (repositórios Git públicos, artigos, open source)
  • Experiência em migrações cloud-to-cloud ou on-premises para OCI
  • Conhecimento de pricing e otimização de custos no OCI
  • Conhecimento de Terragrunt, Ansible ou ferramentas de gerenciamento de configuração
  • Containers: Docker e Kubernetes / OKE
  • Contribuições à comunidade (blog, meetups, palestras sobre OCI ou Terraform)


Certificações - Altamente desejáveis:

  • OCI Architect Professional (1Z0-997)
  • OCI DevOps Professional (1Z0-1109)
  • OCI Security Professional (1Z0-1104)
  • HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003)


Por que trabalhar na VMetrix


En VMetrix não buscamos fazer “mais barulho”, mas construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional.

Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relacionamentos de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, VMetrix é o lugar certo.
